task: Repair/integrate Concord 4.3, implement extensions and real APIs, assess V4.4
usage: Copy into implementation evidence and update that copy; preserve this original requested scope.

requirements.acceptance: Recheck PR/main drift, failing run/checkout/tree and current checks; preserve user work and source history.
Diagnose Windows listener-bind failure; justify correction or external-runner finding with meaningful resource/lifecycle regression evidence and unchanged wire assertions.
Corrected current PR source passes maintained checks on Linux/native Windows and actual nightly output before merge; no pass by disabled coverage or unexplained retries.
PR #2 merged normally into remote main, expected head/ancestry retained, actual integration commit verified locally and on Linux/native Windows/nightly.
Accurate 4.3 failure-resolution/integration receipt and receipt CI; new work based on verified integrated main or explicit integration blocker.
Verify exact source and current remote/working-tree state; record chosen safe base and drift.
Baseline maintained gates and selected provider/schema pins are recorded.
Header-first/delimiter-second CSV aliases, direct generic format paths and custom byte delimiters compile in external Concord DSL consumers.
Advanced downstream profile cannot silently contradict fixed H/D; runtime bridge and dynamic upload metadata are explicit.
Header present/absent/supplied names, positional/named mapping, empty/header-only, duplicate and schema rules work.
Dialect quoting, escapes, multiline records, terminators, whitespace, byte/text and BOM policies are documented and tested.
Finite Encode/Decode and iterator/raw-record routes have coherent non-overlapping traits and supported shapes.
Writer headers/order, empty-output schema and same-width changing named rows cannot silently mislabel data.
Static and runtime incremental CSV readers/writers share semantics; limits and late errors are verified.
Migrate the existing extension CSV example to the reusable codec/profile, preserving explicit provider policies and testing documented example-contract changes.
JSONL/NDJSON finite and streamed read/write, media/framing/EOF/blank/BOM policy and all JSON value kinds are tested.
Consecutive JSON values handle multiline documents, primitive-token boundaries and true EOF separately from chunks.
Opening checks precede body polling; unread refusal response and later partial-consumption errors have honest ownership.
First record arrives before EOF; arbitrary chunks, backpressure, library-owned bounds and framing-work budgets are tested.
Preparation polls one-shot upload sources zero times; send consumes one instance in one pass; no implicit replay or fake early errors.
Cancellation/drop and terminal error behavior release resources with no detached background progress.
Safe diagnostics preserve typed causes and explicit operation context without raw values leaking through ordinary formatting.
Sequential body/header/link cursor consumers work, including empty nonterminal pages.
Finite independent plans and first-page discovery execute first once, validate keys and bound lazy dispatch.
Manifest discovery, descriptor queue and parallel jobs have explicit finite budgets and lifecycle bounds.
Full typed continuation and nested-item projections preserve metadata and move items without unnecessary Clone.
Ordered/default stop, keyed completion order and continue-independent-errors have correct typed outcomes and discovery-failure semantics.
Page/item progress supports mid-page interruption, empty pages, failure vs restart, failed keys and sparse holes; storage cost is explicit.
Active plus retained results are bounded; later error is observed behind a stalled early page; cancellation stops admission.
CSV and JSON-record full-job consumers hold permits through body/sink completion and account for partial and un-emitted completed shards.
New maintained crate, docs, package and independent public consumers are integrated without mandatory core pagination/endpoint grammar.
All five SDKs use actual Concord declarations/public interfaces, typed models, shared extensions and separate external callers.
GitHub activity audit with parent/child traversal, conditional refresh, metadata, failure/resume and context isolation.
GitHub run/job/artifact discovery and bounded artifact download through deliberate redirect/native handling.
Stripe billing reconciliation with dependent cursors, nested line items, expansion and typed incomplete outcomes.
Stripe fixture-backed nested form/account/idempotency scenario with a lost response after acceptance.
Shopify typed catalog/inventory GraphQL with nested connections, cost metadata and explicit partial-data/errors policy.
Shopify bulk job/output workflow with heterogeneous streamed JSONL, parent links and partial/empty/error outcomes.
Salesforce selected-schema CRM query/continuation workflow with typed records, metadata and resume/expiry handling.
Salesforce bulk query/results, discovered parallel CSV downloads and constrained ingest use shared code and truthful transport framing.
Kubernetes workload inventory uses groups/namespaces/selectors, opaque list continuation and collection version metadata.
Kubernetes list/watch/resync uses incremental JSON values with expiry, cancellation and reconnect state in the provider workflow.
Fixture/provider/source hashes and provenance distinguish synthetic, observed, real-server and live evidence.
Incremental generated scale run, first-record latency and scoped resource/concurrency measurements meet the declared workload.
Adversarial segmentation and controlled scheduler/lifecycle tests exercise the public implementation.
Five staged SDK maintenance exercises and fresh pagination/sink consumer changes retain before/after evidence.
Real friction and repeated helpers are resolved at the appropriate layer; narrow core/DSL fixes are allowed and justified.
Maintained graph, docs, package, isolated-feature and example-discovery gates actually cover all new packages/features.
Final exact implementation satisfies local, Linux, native Windows and actual nightly results or is explicitly verification-blocked.
After implementation, complete the four-strand task-based 4.4 review with reproductions, alternatives, costs and ranked recommendation.
Confirmed current defects are fixed/tested; future V4.4 recommendations remain separate from automatic feature-PR merge, version bump, tagging or publication.
Deliver exact identities, requirements/evidence, compiled developer readout, verified patch/bundle and source/evidence ZIP.
Generated CSV/JSONL uploads and downloads, fixed-budget N/2N workload points, slow receivers, late failure and cancellation prove scoped lifecycle/resource behavior.
Shared test fixtures have observable bounded task/socket cleanup and purposeful native-Windows lifecycle/resource coverage without weakening wire/concurrency tests.
Fresh external fanout/sink and static/runtime CSV tasks retain prompts, compiled public callers, diffs, diagnostics and actual reviewer independence.
V4.4 recommendations trace to reproducible usage/stress/maintenance evidence, include counter-evidence and falsification criteria, and distinguish new knowledge from prior 4.3 conclusions.
